gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.title: YM Technicals - set up the CreeperBlaster3000
gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.intro: To add songs by link, the CreeperBlaster3000 needs two free programs. This only matters for your single player and LAN worlds; on servers the server admin decides.
gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.yt_dlp.info: Fetches the audio of YouTube videos. Open source (github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp), about 18 MB. Only used when you paste a YouTube link.
gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.ffmpeg.info: Converts audio into the format Minecraft plays (Ogg Vorbis). Open source builds from github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds, about 100 MB.
gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.manual: Not downloaded: put %s into %s yourself. Programs on the PATH are found as well.
gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.update.info: Checks for a new version at every game start, right in the main menu. YouTube changes often and old versions then stop working. Only for the yt-dlp downloaded here.
gui.ymtechnicals.tools_setup.later: You can change this later in config/ymtechnicals-tools.json.
